text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The spring Classic GⅠ campaign. With the 
three-race showdown against Mr. C.B. 
drawing near—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Uooooooh!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Yes! That felt great!! We can definitely 
conquer that final slope like this...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace admirably acquired the 
fundamental strength and track record 
needed to enter the Satsuki Sho, 
completing her warrior's journey.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to face the real race, 
but—

text_block_list.name: MC
text_block_list.text:
“—With the Satsuki Sho just around the 
corner, is the top contender none other 
than Mr. C.B., who continues his strong 
run from the Yayoi Sho?!”

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"She's a cut above the rest, after all. 
It's only natural. It's more a matter of 
who will come in behind C.B."

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
""As for me, I'd like to keep an eye on 
Sheena Frejus, who gave a powerful 
performance in the Shinzan Kinen. She 
comes from a distinguished family of 
big-race winners, after all—""

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...The public's attention regarding the 
Satsuki Sho is almost entirely focused on 
Mr. C.B., as always."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if other Umamusume are barely brought 
up, the reality is that Katsuragi Ace's 
name is never mentioned at all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure Katsuragi Ace would say that. 
And I feel the exact same way."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is barely any time left before the 
Satsuki Sho, but there are still things I 
can do, like updating the data on the 
other runners...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right up until the big moment, I must give 
everything I have to what I can do. 
Stoking the flame within, I began to get 
to work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, around that time—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Considering how CB ran the last time I 
saw her race, there's no telling how much 
stronger she's gotten...)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(I have to push myself to the absolute 
limit...! So I can cross the finish line 
even a single millimeter ahead of her!)
—Such fierce, relentless training.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: You are...――

...We haven't had many chances to talk 
like this before, have we, Katsuragi 
Ace-san?

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
I am Shiina Frejus. I am the Umamusume who 
will face you in the Satsuki Sho. Pleased 
to make your acquaintance.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...I know. I'm not that stupid, you know. 
I've been studying the other Umamusume 
besides C.B. too.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Sheena Frejus. Born into a prestigious 
racing family, with certified talent to 
back it up. She's undoubtedly one of the 
top runners of our generation—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
“It's surprising, though. You going out of 
your way to talk to me, I mean. I'm not 
C.B., you know?”

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
—Is this your attempt at getting back at 
me? It is only natural that I study every 
Umamusume in the race, including you.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"And I— value you more than anyone else 
does."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "...Say what? You're... evaluating me?"

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
—You knocked on the gates of Tracen 
Academy with nothing to your name, paid no 
mind to the voices around you, and trained 
relentlessly.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"Even amidst those who grew complacent in 
their environment, or those who felt the 
gap and grew envious, she remained 
unswervingly straightforward—"

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
Having outstripped countless rivals along 
the way, she is now poised to take on the 
Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"I am not so senile as to overlook such a 
monumental leap forward."

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, how she spoke up to CB-san 
earlier... Anyone with ordinary courage 
couldn't possibly pull that off.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
—A strong warrior with an unyielding 
heart, who climbed to the top through 
extraordinary effort. That is my 
evaluation of you.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...You're praising me too much. I just 
gave it everything I had, that's all."

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
...That's a very fitting way for you to 
take it.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
However, please remember this. Just as you 
have poured in endless effort, I, too, 
have undergone rigorous training.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
I take pride in having walked this path 
without arrogance, never bringing shame to 
the prestigious Shiina name. ...With that, 
let me declare it.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
—The one who will conquer the Satsuki Sho 
is me.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
I will defeat all of you together— you, 
CB-san, and every other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: ...Please, prepare yourself.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Bring it on! Let's see what you've got, 
Fréjus!

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
......That is all I came to say. My 
apologies for interrupting your 
self-training. All that is left is the 
Satsuki Sho—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(...So there was someone else besides me 
burning up with a desire to take down 
C.B....!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Natural, isn't it. That is the Classic 
Triple Crown— the battlefield where the 
strongest of our generation clash...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I will win, no matter what...!! Against 
C.B., against Fréjus, against every other 
Umamusume, all of them...!!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...The Satsuki Sho, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ah— I can't wait for the gates to open—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The hopes of those gazing upward unite in 
the sky, eventually connecting to the 
Satsuki Sho—
